title: Activate Dynamic Governance-Controlled Emissions: 60/40 Split
summary: Activate governance-controlled emissions with 60% to validators and 40% to AI inference rewards
description: Activate the dynamic governance-controlled emissions system with a 60% allocation to validators (fee_collector) and 40% allocation to AI inference rewards (inferencerewards module). This proposal will replace the current hardcoded mint distribution with a governance-controlled system that can be adjusted through future proposals.
